keyPoints: Gunankhand (factorisation) me vyanjak ko gunon ke roop me toda jaata hai — 6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3) — koshthak ke bahar common gunankhand likho.
Pehle sarv-nishth gunankhand (common factor) nikalo — 4x² + 8x me 4x common hai: 4x(x + 2).
Samuh-baddh karke gunankhand: ax + bx + ay + by = x(a+b) + y(a+b) = (a+b)(x+y).
Sarv-samikaon se gunankhand: a² - b² = (a+b)(a-b); x² + 2xy + y² = (x+y)² — pehchano ki vyanjak kaun si sarv-samika jaisa dikhta hai.
x² + (a+b)x + ab = (x+a)(x+b) — madhya pad ko aise todo ki guna akhiri pad de — jaise x² + 5x + 6 = (x+2)(x+3).
Bhaag me pehle ansh aur har ka gunankhand karo, phir common kaato: (x²-4)/(x+2) = x - 2 — kaatne se pehle poora gunankhand zaroori hai.
Aam galti: x² + 9 ko (x+3)(x+3) likhna — (x+3)² = x² + 6x + 9 hota hai, beech ka pad mat bhoolo.
